limitations: Only local Message append and existing Network name update/delete are certified. No actual IRC network connection, message delivery, commands, proxy/SASL or uploaded bytes.
Network.uuid is literal text; input schema corrected to its declared key type. Source network_create lacks UUID assignment and is not certified.

Any signed-in user can read/edit/delete any Network and append history for nonexistent target channel; no per-user network ownership or target membership guard exists. Actual cross-user write and missing-target append are probed. Original set_on_create constant resolves message type, now explicitly state-probed.
